title: Acknowledge live PR rule attention in Command Center
description: Run alongside e2e-pr-rule-actions.mts with RULE_ACK_VIA_UI=1. Use the notification ID emitted by that live gateway scenario. Its finally block disables the validation rule and stops its monitor. Set PR_RULE_NOTIFICATION_ID to the same ID for the gateway assertion.

open-prs.intent: The PR dashboard exposes persisted rule attention independently of runs.

wait-panel.intent: The connected dashboard provides authoritative monitoring and rule controls.

open-rules.intent: Open the Automation section before selecting its settings view.

wait-notification.intent: The real GitHub-backed match is visible as an unacknowledged attention item.

show-notification.intent: Match provenance and the acknowledgement control are readable together.

capture.intent: The captured attention item shows the actual PR, team and match reason.

acknowledge.intent: The operator acknowledges this notification without changing the rule or monitor policy.

verify.intent: A new gateway read proves that acknowledgement was persisted for this recipient.

open-rules-workspace-view.intent: The operator can inspect current matches and their requested actions.
